description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) SHIELD OF HONOUR (Guardians of the Throne, 1 CP) — WP-C5. Fixture cus11e_c5_active (P1 Custodes active, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_cus11e_c5_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Custodes detachment flipped (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, Trajann's Moment Shackle marked spent (its prompt is not under test), the Custodes unreadied (Martial Ka'tah not under test), straight to the phase under test; the Custodian Wardens are moved into engagement with the Boyz too (beside Custodian Guard A). Entering the Fight phase opens fight_phase_start for P1; a real click on 'Use on Custodian Guard...' spends 1 CP. Effect: when a Boyz model (engaged with the Guard) selects targets other than the Guard — the Wardens — its attacks get -1 to hit and -1 to wound; attacks on the Guard itself are unaffected.
